**Could you provide any sort of Log of the crash?
be it Godot's own logging, or via ADB?**

...

-In my app I set the Min SDK to 27 right now, that's Android 8.1,
as previous versions seem to have incompatibility problems..

Namely I was getting lots of Crashes, and Admob Plugin related Crashes on Android 8.0 devices, 
but for the wrong Java or GPU reasons...

It was mostly two main types of problems:

1.- Java / Manifest issue (Android 8.0):
IllegalStateException: Only fullscreen opaque activities can request orientation — happening in GodotActivity.onCreate. 
Caused by Godot’s splash screen theme + screenOrientation="portrait".

2.- GPU / Native crash (rare, on very old hardware):
SIGSEGV at garbage addresses (like 0xff00ff00),
typical of broken/old Mali GPU drivers + memory corruption on ancient devices.

Classic problems of supporting very old Android versions.
However it's true they concentrated on Android 8.0 and some 8.1 devices.

No direct problems with Android 7 and below, but very few Android 7 users ever installed/tried the app anyway..

In any case, raising the Min SDK bar to 27 has been positive for my app,
99% of crashes are gone now, and there's still a good 16K+ compatible devices.. (16,633 to be exact..)

Haven't tried to run it via adb, gonna try later and ill pass the log
Raising the minsdk can be a solution still it should work  if the android exporter put the minsdk at 24 by default
Its a moto g 2013 (Snapdragon 400) running lineageos android 7.1, not sure if it matters it being a custom rom but never had a problem before as i said in godot 4.6.3 it works

Logs would definitely be useful to understand what is happening. Since it is a regression relative to 4.6.3 it would be good to investigate what may have caused it. Please update the issue once you have them.
